Overview

George Town is a city in Penang with a population of 794,000. Penang’s UNESCO-listed capital, famous for its street art, colonial architecture, and world-renowned street food. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
